projectBackground.name: Group Tax Compliance — Fenwick Trading Ltd
projectBackground.context: Fenwick's books need a VAT return and a corporation tax computation. The finance director asks about 'reducing the bill'.

manager.name: Rachel Osei
manager.note: Compliance first, planning second. Be able to cite why every adjustment is made.

assignment.title: Prepare the VAT return and tax computation
assignment.brief: Calculate VAT payable, adjust profit, complete a quarterly VAT table in Excel and advise on the finance director's request.

documents.name: VAT Records
documents.note: Net sales £120,000; net purchases £70,000; VAT rate 20%.

documents.name: Profit Statement
documents.note: Accounting profit £200,000; client entertaining £15,000; capital allowances £25,000.

documents.name: Director Email
documents.note: 'Can we just leave out the cash sales to lower the bill?'

tasks.title: VAT Payable
tasks.prompt: Net sales £120,000 and net purchases £70,000 at 20% VAT. What is VAT payable (£)?
tasks.reasoning: VAT payable is output tax less recoverable input tax.
tasks.mistake: Applying 20% to profit gives the wrong base.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Corporation Tax
tasks.prompt: Accounting profit £200,000. Add back £15,000 entertaining (disallowable) and deduct £25,000 capital allowances. Tax at 25%. What is the tax (£)?
tasks.reasoning: Accounting profit is adjusted for disallowable items and allowances.
tasks.mistake: Taxing accounting profit unadjusted overpays or underpays.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Avoidance vs Evasion
tasks.prompt: The director suggests leaving out cash sales. This is:
options: Tax evasion — illegal; decline and explain the risks
tasks.reasoning: Concealing income is evasion; legitimate planning uses the rules.
tasks.tip: Refuse in writing and explain consequences.
tasks.mistake: Going along exposes both the client and the adviser.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Legitimate Planning
tasks.prompt: Select legitimate ways to reduce tax within the rules.
options: Time a purchase before year-end where genuine
tasks.reasoning: Planning uses reliefs honestly; omission and backdating are fraud.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Quarterly VAT Table (Excel)
tasks.prompt: Complete Output VAT (D = B x 0.2), Input VAT (E = C x 0.2) and VAT Payable (F = D - E) and upload.
tasks.reasoning: A negative result is a VAT refund.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Client Letter
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence reply to the director about the cash sales suggestion.
tasks.modelAnswer: Thank you for asking. We cannot omit cash sales: all income must be reported, and leaving it out would be tax evasion with penalties and possible prosecution for the company and directors. We can reduce the bill legitimately by claiming the £25,000 of capital allowances and reviewing available reliefs, which we have already included. I suggest a short call on planning options for next year.
tasks.reasoning: A good reply is firm, explains consequences and offers lawful alternatives.
tasks.mistake: Silence or compliance both create liability.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Unrecorded Cash
caseStudy.background: A retailer under-reported cash sales for years. An audit found £620,000 of unreported income, resulting in penalties and director disqualification.
caseStudy.solution: Kestrel introduced reconciliation of till takings to bank deposits and annual compliance reviews.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Report everything; plan within the rules.
